chooseTask.en: What do you want to do?

summary.en: Train on anvils, break through floors and turn rare rocks into materials with your cutting machines.

label.en: Getting Started: Train, Mine, Cut and Sell

description.en: Follow the mining loop and recognize the return, cutting and selling controls.

label.en: Rock Cutting Machines: Loading and Upgrading

description.en: Keep machines occupied, collect finished materials and read upgrade costs before spending.

label.en: Pickaxes, Pocket and Eyesight Upgrades

description.en: Choose an upgrade according to the part of the mining loop that slows you down.

label.en: Floors, Rock Rarity and the Index

description.en: Read the room panel before farming a rarity and keep collection rewards separate from drop odds.
